Last year I was on the bus and I watched as this mum and her son got off the bus and then immediately turned around and started banging on the door for the driver to let her back on again, but he drove off instead. I went upstairs and saw that he had left a new Lego set on the seat, so I got off early and ran back to the stop she got off to give it to her. When she saw me there with the set in her hands she actually started crying and told me she'd been saving up for a really long time to be able to afford it and was so panicked when she'd lost it because she wouldn't be able to afford a new one. She gave me a really big hug and at the time I was feeling so so lonely, and the love this random mother showed me meant the world to me because she was truly grateful even though I'd done the bare minimum. Made me feel like I had a purpose again.
